newsitem.title: PERU: Two policemen die, two others hurt in Peru ambush.
newsitem.headline: Two policemen die, two others hurt in Peru ambush.

text.p: Two Peruvian policemen died and two others were injured on Tuesday night when gunmen ambushed two patrol cars transporting a suspected criminal on a highway north of Lima, police said.
A police spokesman told Reuters that a group of heavily armed assailants intercepted the vehicles and opened fire on them on the Panamerican Highway 12 miles (19.5 kms) north of the city.
"There were eight or 10 criminals who battled with police for 10 to 15 minutes," the spokesman said, adding police accompanied by prosecutor Karina Chavez were transporting a member of a gang.
The prosecutor was uninjured in the incident, which occurred at about 8:30 p.m. (0130 GMT), police said.

Anti-terrorist police said they were investigating the attack for possible links to one of Peru's two leftist rebel groups but police sources said the attack appears more likely to be the work of gang members.
It was not clear if the attack was related to a bombing at a power firm, also in northern Lima, several hours later.
No injuries were reported in the blast, which is being investigated by police bomb experts and the anti-terrorist police DINCOTE.
